content.short: The exclusive NFT marketplace by AdaSwap is one of the most anticipated projects in the Cardano Ecosystem.
content.description: ADANFT is a Cardano NFT marketplace project created within the AdaSwap ecosystem. It was designed to give Cardano artists, collectors, and projects a dedicated venue for trading digital collectibles while connecting NFT activity with AdaSwap's wider DeFi products. The marketplace focuses on wallet-based NFT discovery and exchange for the Cardano community. As part of AdaSwap's broader roadmap, ADANFT adds a creator and collector layer beside token swaps, launchpad tools, and other ecosystem services.
content.meta: ADANFT is AdaSwap's Cardano NFT marketplace for creators, collectors, and digital collectibles. Explore ADANFT on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
